items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: And I played with Albert French's office. He has a tuxedo band. I played with him on the out-of-town engagements

ctx.x: In those days, I didn't know everybody in the band. I didn't know for sure who I heard.

And... After playing with the Four Tones, I began to...we broke up. And I played just as I would be called. Then I later joined Herbert Leary's Orchestra. And I played with him up until now. And about a year and a half ago, I came in charge of the band at the Paddock Lounge. That's how I got to Dixieland Group. And I played with Albert French's office. He has a tuxedo band. I played with him on the out-of-town engagements because his bass players sometimes can't get away from work.
Yes, he told me that. And I'm hoping I'd catch you sometime with him, but I didn't... Yes. And now you have your own group down there on St. Peter's Street at Haysha. So, this is really a nice group.
